resources.string: Install one from the Chrome Web Store, or pick a .crx/.xpi file on this device.
Browse the store inside MobiBrowser. When you land on an extension page, MobiBrowser offers to install it.
Extension detected on this page — install

GeckoView only installs Mozilla-signed extensions. This one was converted and runs through MobiBrowser compatibility bridge: content scripts and styles work, privileged APIs (blocking webRequest, debugger, tabCapture) do not.
MobiBrowser runs on GeckoView and installs WebExtensions: from the Chrome Web Store (manifest converted for you) or from local .crx/.xpi files. It also runs your own user scripts and CSS.
This is an unstable build: test it and report what breaks. Avoid sensitive accounts.
